_doc: How each word of word_pass_1.json gets its picture, decided before any generation (Mark 2026-10-25). Words not listed are ordinary generated pictograms. 'code' tiles are rendered by a tool, never generated, because their meaning is arithmetic (a cell in a strip, a clock's hands) or a shared frame (the month page). 'glyph' tiles are the word set as text (render_word_glyphs.py), used only where the word's home page is mostly text or the word belongs to a text family; on BlasterAI 60's picture-dominant pages an abstract word gets a diagram, gesture or small scene instead (Mark, after review 1). 'series' words share one drawing with only the meaningful part changing (draw_series.py, tools/board_spec/series.json). 'hard' words are generated but expected to need rework: abstract, relational or easily confused.

code._how: render_strips.py: the day strip with that day's cell lit. render_clocks.py: a clock face with the hands set. render_months.py: one calendar page for every month, the name in its band and a generated seasonal picture (tools/board_spec/month_icons.json) on top, Avaz's approach.

glyph._how: render_word_glyphs.py, per style. Text only, so a language variant is data.

diagram._how: Generated pictures for abstract words that were text in the first draft: a diagram, a gesture or a small scene.

series._how: One generated source per series; the variants are image edits of it so only the meaning changes.

hard._how: Generated, reviewed against the ARASAAC reference, expected to need a second prompt.
